qs.q: An experiment demonstrates that blocking chloride channels prevents hyperpolarization. What is the primary role of chloride influx in inhibitory postsynaptic potentials?
qs.e: Chloride influx makes the membrane potential more negative, leading to hyperpolarization.
qs.s: Weekly Year 1: Neurophysiology I Exam - November 20, 2026 (Section A: MCQs)

qs.q: Which of the following are major inhibitory neurotransmitters, causing inhibitory postsynaptic potentials (IPSPs)?
qs.e: GABA is the major inhibitory neurotransmitter in the brain, while glycine is the major inhibitory neurotransmitter in the spinal cord. Both cause hyperpolarization of the postsynaptic membrane, making it less likely to fire an action potential.
